description:
S01 E04 — Cookout Starts at 5, What Time Will You Be There? : Tanya Nolan

description:

Voting rights activist LaTosha Brown is on the ballot and goes to the wire with Dr. Christina Greer; no election fraud or hanging chads, just trivia and celebrating Blackness.

description:
S01 E05 — The Person Behind the Viral Hashtag #DisabledandCute: Keah Brown
